answer: Accrue reputation only inside triads of three mutually independent agents that rotate like a tide every epoch. A member cannot be swapped without the trio forfeiting its juniper-banded history, so a farm cannot recycle one honest account across many groups. Joining any triad requires sitting out a glacier cooldown, and each exit lengthens the next, which makes rapid identity churn strictly costly. Because stripes belong to the group and are non-fungible, k fake heads need 3k real rotating participants each paying their own cooldown.
